objective: Test whether waiting for a real adverse market move after the frozen proxy entry signal can improve entry quality without destroying useful trade frequency.

trigger_reference.reference_price: original signal M1 BID open, not executable Ask entry price
trigger_reference.reason: Avoid treating bid/ask spread as market pullback.

causal_execution.touch_detection: Use completed M1 high/low to detect first pullback threshold touch; never enter inside that same M1 bar.
causal_execution.touch_entry: Enter at next observed M1 open after the completed trigger bar.
causal_execution.rebound_detection: After pullback touch, track running adverse extreme. Use completed M1 close to confirm recovery from that extreme by the frozen rebound amount.
causal_execution.rebound_entry: Enter at next observed M1 open after completed rebound-confirmation bar.
causal_execution.long_entry: next M1 bid open + historical spread * SYMBOL_POINT
causal_execution.exit_anchor: Original frozen M8B exit M1 open, exploratory entry-quality comparison only.
